title: Creative Assessment
shortDescription: Divergent thinking, originality, flexibility and problem reframing, with open-text responses and AI-assisted interpretation.
longDescription: Creative Assessment measures divergent thinking, originality, flexibility, and problem-reframing ability through a mix of closed-form pattern/ideation items (deterministically scored) and open-ended written prompts (AI-interpreted only, never scored deterministically).
sourceNote: Ported verbatim from airostudio/Creative-Assessment (questions.js) — 15 real questions (13 closed-form, 2 open-ended). Per platform policy, the two open_creative questions never feed the deterministic score; they're passed to the AI interpretation layer only.

sections.name: Core Creative Assessment
sections.description: Closed-form items covering visual pattern recognition, ideation, problem solving, flexibility, and innovation, each scored deterministically.
sections.instructions: Choose the option that best fits each prompt. Some items include an image or a slider scale.

sections.name: Creative Expression
sections.description: Open-ended written prompts that surface divergent thinking and imaginative expression. These responses are AI-interpreted and do not contribute to the deterministic score.
sections.instructions: Write freely — there are no right or wrong answers here.

scoringDimensions.label: Creative
scoringDimensions.description: Overall composite creativity score aggregating visual creativity, ideation, problem solving, flexibility, and innovation.

scoringDimensions.label: Visual Creativity
scoringDimensions.description: Pattern recognition and aesthetic sense, measured through visual pattern completion and image-selection items.

scoringDimensions.label: Ideation
scoringDimensions.description: Idea generation and divergent thinking, measured through alternative-uses and brainstorming items.

scoringDimensions.label: Problem Solving
scoringDimensions.description: Creative and analytical approaches to solving constrained or contradictory problems.

scoringDimensions.label: Flexibility
scoringDimensions.description: Adaptability and openness to changing approach, especially after negative feedback or a failed first attempt.

scoringDimensions.label: Innovation
scoringDimensions.description: Novel thinking and risk-taking when facing seemingly impossible challenges.

resultRanges.title: Developing
resultRanges.description: Your creative thinking is still emerging. You tend to favor familiar, well-trodden solutions over novel ones, and may hesitate to change course once you've picked an approach.
recommendations: Practice brainstorming without judging ideas — quantity first, quality later.
Deliberately generate multiple unrelated uses for everyday objects.
Seek out feedback and treat it as raw material rather than criticism.

resultRanges.title: Average
resultRanges.description: You show a moderate capacity for creative thinking, with occasional flashes of originality, but your ideas often stay close to conventional patterns.
recommendations: Push past your first three ideas — the most original ones tend to come later.
Try reframing problems from a completely different perspective before solving them.
Expose yourself to unfamiliar visual styles and disciplines regularly.

resultRanges.title: Strong
resultRanges.description: You demonstrate solid creative range — comfortable generating alternatives, spotting patterns, and adjusting your approach when something isn't working.
recommendations: Stretch further into unconventional or paradox-embracing solutions.
Pair your idea generation with faster experimentation cycles.
Mentor others in divergent-thinking techniques to sharpen your own.

resultRanges.title: Very Strong
resultRanges.description: You think fluently and flexibly, generating many original ideas and reframing problems with ease. You're comfortable with ambiguity and contradiction.
recommendations: Channel your fluency into structured creative projects with real constraints.
Explore cross-domain inspiration to keep pushing originality further.
Practice articulating the 'why' behind your creative choices for collaborators.

resultRanges.title: Exceptional
resultRanges.description: Your creative thinking is exceptional — highly original, fluent, and adaptable across visual, verbal, and problem-solving domains.
recommendations: Take on ambiguous, high-stakes creative challenges that stretch your range.
Share your process to help build creative capacity in others.
Protect deliberate space for unstructured exploration to sustain originality.
